howto.title: How to play
howto.1.title: Two secret teams
howto.1.text: Your phone deals you a role. Most players are Good knights. A few are Evil, and they know each other. Nobody else knows who is who.
howto.2.title: The leader picks a team
howto.2.text: Each round one player leads and picks who goes on the quest. Talk, accuse, defend. The leader role moves one seat clockwise after every vote.
howto.3.title: Everyone votes, then it's public
howto.3.text: Approve or Reject, in secret. Then every vote is shown by name. Five rejected teams in a row and Evil wins. Votes are your best clue: check History often.
howto.4.title: The quest: one Fail sinks it
howto.4.text: The team secretly plays Success or Fail. Good can only play Success. Cards are shuffled, so you only learn how many Fails, never who.
howto.5.title: First to three quests
howto.5.text: Three Successes and Good is close to winning. Three Fails and Evil wins. With 7 or more players, Quest 4 needs two Fails to fail.
howto.6.title: The final twist
howto.6.text: Merlin knows Evil but must stay hidden. If Good wins three quests, the Assassin gets one guess at Merlin. Guess right and Evil steals the win.
